records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/README.md
records.summary: Shantytown coordinates owned work for a crew through explicit capacity limits, tracker adapters, scheduled passes and recorded outcomes. Quipu integration remains optional.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fdesign.md
records.summary: Tracker and pane protocols separate work storage from session transport. Dispatch verification reads back delivery; refusal and dry-run outcomes preserve explicit uncertainty.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shantytown/shantytown%2Fcli.py
records.summary: st manages work, crew, repos and jobs. Governed roles/ranks preserve UNKNOWN. Protected mailboxes/reviews bind scopes. Cycle needs clean branches/full-history custody; checkpoints need fresh proof. Chaski delegation refuses local execution. Administrators accept quarantined ranks. Harness conversion validates model/browser. Semantic benchmarks never admit ranks. Pipeline waits need events/backstops; --window is an appointment. Owner reminders retain gates. Ceiling transfer checks source harness, complete non-held receiver plate, alternate harness, budget and ownership. Seeds revision fences and structured conflicts preserve operation identity without retry. AGY hook projection is not native SessionStart proof; missing evidence is UNKNOWN. Sweeps resume at first budget skip. Verified ordinary administrator/Codex cold-launch receipts resume work without launching; independent holds remain. Native priority uses lean rows or UNKNOWN. Create advice proves selected store; skips separate.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shantytown/shantytown%2Fconfig.py
records.summary: The configuration reader resolves shantytown.toml and declared environment settings. Local file-backed operation remains available independently of graph integration. The jobs.scheduler setting selects local execution by default or explicit Chaski delegation; invalid declarations and non-absence file-read errors refuse. Only an absent local file retains the built-in default behavior; best-effort supervision can report a fallback without granting local-job execution. Agent harness conversion retains validated per-harness model and browser preferences; unsupported optional fields are reported and omitted from launch commands. The inbox.store setting selects legacy seed pointers by default or the isolated Message graph; invalid or unknown declarations refuse.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fintegrations.md
records.summary: Optional Quipu, Seeds, Bobbin and Yupana integration supplies shared registry, work tracking, context and structural policy through configured adapters.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/CONTRIBUTING.md
records.summary: The package keeps zero runtime dependencies and Python 3.11 as its compatibility floor. Existing source checks and the built console entry point must remain verifiable.
